clips.title: The story
paras: In Deathknell, Scavenger Paw comes from the young, ragged wolves roaming the hills. Newly awakened Forsaken gather the severed paws for local caretakers to stitch into crude protective gear.

Deathknell's newly returned Forsaken have little to spare. The Scourge and the Scarlet Crusade press against Tirisfal, so every scrap of hide and bone goes to practical use. Novice Elreth assists Shadow Priest Sarvis and gathers paws from scavenger wolves, along with bat wings. She uses them to make serviceable garments and armor for Forsaken who have just risen from their graves, still disoriented by their return.
